concerns.text: FR-001 assumes that the Materials Project and AFLOWlib APIs provide metallic‑glass (amorphous) entries with measured CTE values and a `material_type` flag. In reality these databases contain only crystalline DFT data and do not expose amorphous/metallic‑glass classifications or experimental CTE measurements for glasses. This makes the core construct (composition → CTE for metallic glasses) untestable with the specified data sources, violating construct validity and rendering the research question infeasible.
